channel.title: Infinite blog
channel.description: Notes on building and using Infinite, the free open-source DAW for visuals, music and code.

item.title: Linux DAW workflows: modular audio, VST3 hosting and live visuals
item.description: Explore modular music production on Linux with Infinite: a Linux DAW to route synthesiser graphs, host Linux VST3 plugins, and patch audio into live visuals.

item.title: Generative visuals in live performance: audio, nodes and GPU
item.description: Build robust generative visuals for live performance with audio FFT analysis, GPU shaders, procedural geometry, and stable feedback loops in Infinite.

item.title: Open source VJ software: real-time visual performance in Infinite
item.description: Build real-time generative visuals, map live audio frequencies, and drive stage projection with Infinite, an open source VJ software workstation for performers.

item.title: Automatic visuals for DJ sets: hands-free live visuals in Infinite
item.description: Generate hands-free, audio-reactive visuals for DJ sets in Infinite using live audio analysis, frequency-split modulation, and hardware projection.

item.title: Node-based DAW workflows: modular audio routing on an infinite canvas
item.description: Explore node-based DAW workflows in Infinite: wire synths, route MIDI into generative sequencers, and patch audio directly into live visual shaders.

item.title: Every note node in Infinite: generative arpeggiators and algorithmic sequencing
item.description: Explore all 24 note nodes in Infinite: algorithmic arpeggiators, scale quantizers, Markov chains, chord generators, humanizers, and generative note logic.

item.title: Every synthesizer node in Infinite: the complete sound design guide
item.description: The complete guide to all 20 synthesizer nodes in Infinite: subtractive, wavetable, FM, physical modeling, granular, spectral resynthesis, and DSP kernels.

item.title: Raymarching signed distance fields in real-time GLSL
item.description: How to build a real-time raymarcher in GLSL: sphere tracing algorithm, primitive distance functions, smooth blending, normals, and audio-reactive scenes.

item.title: Real-time fluid simulation in GLSL: Navier-Stokes and dye advection
item.description: How to implement real-time Eulerian fluid simulation in GLSL: velocity advection, multigrid pressure solves, vorticity confinement, and audio reactivity.

item.title: Reaction-diffusion simulation in real-time GLSL
item.description: How to build a reaction-diffusion simulation in real-time GLSL shaders and nodes, creating generative Turing patterns with audio-reactive parameter modulation.

item.title: Audio-reactive GLSL shaders: writing real-time visuals in Infinite
item.description: Learn how to write real-time audio-reactive GLSL shaders in Infinite, map FFT frequency bands to shader uniforms, and generate responsive visuals on the GPU.

item.title: Lorenz attractor interactive simulation in creative coding
item.description: How to build a Lorenz attractor interactive simulation in real time using differential equations, interactive Sketch code, and audio modulation.

item.title: PaulStretch on Mac: extreme spectral time stretching in Infinite
item.description: Explore PaulStretch on Mac with Infinite. Learn how real-time spectral time stretching, phase randomisation, and FFT analysis turn audio into ambient drones.

item.title: Euclidean rhythm sequencer algorithms for modular music
item.description: How to generate Euclidean rhythm sequencer algorithms using Bjorklund integer distribution, modular arithmetic, and audio-reactive triggers in Infinite.

item.title: Embedding interactive audio-reactive WebGL visuals on any website
item.description: How to embed responsive, microphone-reactive 3D WebGL visualisers into portfolios, documentation, and blogs using self-contained HTML iframes.

item.title: unique nodes in infinite: wave terrain, shape resonator, cymatics
item.description: explore infinite original nodes: convert images to sound with wave terrain, ring 3d geometry with shape resonator, and simulate chladni cymatics.

item.title: AI agent MCP guide for audio and visual synthesis
item.description: Connect AI coding agents to Infinite via MCP and Python SDK for headless audio synthesis, 3D meshes, and video rendering.

item.title: AI agents make music, art and 3D with Infinite headless engine
item.description: Infinite headless engine lets AI agents write text patches, inspect signals, and render music, pictures and 3D from the command line.

item.title: writing audio dsp without juce: notes from infinite
item.description: why infinite's audio engine is written in modern c++ without a framework, and what that changes for real-time safety.

item.title: Sound design in Infinite: sub bass, plucks, and pads
item.description: Guide to modular sound design in Infinite DAW: subtractive sub bass, Karplus-Strong plucks, and ambient pads with Field kernels.

item.title: Hardware MIDI and controller mapping in Infinite
item.description: Connect hardware synthesizers, MIDI controllers, and DMX lighting to Infinite with low latency routing and parameter modulation.

item.title: javascript sketches as nodes: draw with code, wire it to anything
item.description: how sketch nodes let you draw with javascript in infinite and expose real modulation pins to synths and audio signals.

item.title: Writing 48kHz audio DSP kernels in Field language
item.description: Breakdown of Infinite register machine for Field Synth and Effect nodes, compiling per-sample audio DSP kernels at 48kHz.

item.title: Procedural 3D geometry and audio mesh deformation
item.description: Build procedural 3D meshes in Infinite DAW, deform topology with Field modifier kernels, and drive real-time geometric mutations.

item.title: Bringing Shadertoy GLSL shaders into Infinite for audio reactivity
item.description: How to convert any Shadertoy fragment shader into a native real-time node in Infinite, hook it up to audio analysis FFT bands, and export high-resolution video.

item.title: Field: write a short kernel and let the node decide where it runs
item.description: Field is the language built into Infinite. One kernel can become a shader, a geometry deformer or an audio effect, depending on the node it lives in.

item.title: A free TouchDesigner alternative for audio-reactive visuals?
item.description: An honest look at where Infinite fits next to TouchDesigner for audio-reactive visuals and VJ work, and where TouchDesigner is still the better choice.

item.title: Infinite v0.6 benchmarks: where it is fast and where it is not
item.description: Infinite benchmarks on a base MacBook Air M2 against Blender, Vital, Serum 2 and popular DAWs, with the results published, including where Infinite is slower.

item.title: Make your first audio-reactive visual in Infinite
item.description: A beginner walkthrough from a free template to a shape that moves with your music, using the Audio Analyze node and a single cable.

item.title: Modulate any VST3 or AU plugin with LFOs, audio and visuals
item.description: Load a third-party plugin into Infinite and drive its parameters from an LFO, an envelope follower or something moving on screen.

item.title: Free motion tracking for music and visuals in Infinite
item.description: Hand Track, Face Track and Pose Track turn a camera or picture into modulators, so a pinch, a smile or a raised arm can drive any parameter in your patch.

item.title: One graph for sound and pictures: how Infinite keeps them in step
item.description: Infinite runs a pull-based audio graph and a GPU texture pipeline off one BPM transport, so audio can drive visuals and visuals can drive audio.

item.title: Render video and audio from a text file with no window open
item.description: Infinite's headless mode turns a plain-text patch into stills, video and a loudness report from the command line. Here is the five-minute workflow.
